name: NuPhy PRD Clarifier
short_description: Turn vague NuPhy operations requests into clear requirement cards and PRD drafts.
long_description: NuPhy PRD Clarifier guides operations teammates through focused, step-by-step questions. It identifies missing context, separates facts from assumptions, creates testable acceptance criteria, and outputs both a Feishu-ready requirement entry and a lightweight PRD draft. It does not change code, publish content, write to Feishu, or decide final priority and engineering complexity.
countries_and_regions: Choose only regions supported by NuPhy legal and support teams in the submission portal.
